title: Petar Curic TV - Videos
description:
Petar Ćurić (Pronounced: PAY:tar / CHEW:rich) is a Croatian-born, USA/UK-educated producer and consultant working primarily in the field of culture management, education, branding, and public diplomacy. He has 15 years of experience in the event industry at the international level, and has collaborated with the likes of Bill Bruford (YES, King Crimson), Dieter Flury (Vienna Philharmonic), Steve Gadd (Eric Clapton), Gerald Heyward (Beyonce, Jay-Z), Mirko Novosel (International Basketball Hall of Fame), Mate Rimac (Rimac-Bugatti), Zagreb Philharmonic and many others.

Petar was an Advisory Board Member to the President of Croatia, Mrs. Kolinda Grabar-Kitarovic (2018-2020) for public diplomacy and national brand development.
